sources.observation: The plan fixes the connections between the eastern and western corridors, Honsha, Marodo and the open decks.
Raised boards, dark green lattice panels and vermilion columns identify the waterfront halls.
Two main camphor pillars, four braces, two crossbars and the upswept bark roof make the distinct offshore gate silhouette.

limitations: Mapped footprints and the site plan fix the main volumes and the offshore gate bearing. The open deck layout, roof heights, individual bay spacing, pier depths and painted details use exterior approximations.
Sea level is the local height datum. The supplied high-tide fixture illustrates the construction above the inlet. Tides and the local shore height are approximate.
This model covers the waterfront complex and Great Torii. Adjacent buildings, hills and shoreline are supplied by the host.
